title: Typed Dictionary values not saving on custom Resources
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.4.dev7.official [46c8f8c5c]

### System information

Godot v4.4.dev7 - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6109) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

When extending the `Resource` class to create a `CustomResource` of some kind and exporting a typed Dictionary variable, the values of the typed Dictionary are not saved to disk on new resource file creation (`.res` or `.tres`).

```gdscript
class_name CustomResource extends Resource

@export var name: String # Will be saved
@export var typed_dict: Dictionary[String, int] # ERROR Won't be saved
```

### Steps to reproduce

On any project:

1. Create a script for a `CustomResource` class extending `Resource`
2. Write a typed Dictionary variable for the `CustomResource` class, like: `@export var typed_dict: Dictionary[String, int]`
3. Create and save a`CustomResource` as a `.res` or `.tres` file
4. Reopen or run the project to see the saved `.res` or `.tres` file and if the values of the typed Dictionary has been saved

On the MRP

1. Modify the typed Dictionary values of the `my_custom_resource.tres` file
2. Run the project and check the Output to see the `CustomResource` variables values printed
